tools.description: How to design rate limits for a public API
tools.name: get_api_rate_limit_guide

snippets.body: Token bucket allows brief bursts while maintaining a long-term average rate; fixed window is simpler but permits 2x spikes at window boundaries. For agent traffic (bursty, programmatic), token bucket with a modest burst size is the safer default.
snippets.title: Token bucket vs fixed window

snippets.body: Retry at 1s, 2s, 4s, 8s, 16s with ±25% jitter, then dead-letter. Cap total attempts at 5. Always sign payloads (HMAC-SHA256) so receivers can verify authenticity on retry.
snippets.title: Exponential backoff with jitter
